The fix is commit `0e06523b799319ec65716df66eafb32aef170b3c` (PR #3792, ticket O3-6100, "Prevent duplicate vitals saves"). It adds one `return` in front of the `createOrUpdateVitalsAndBiometrics(...)` call, so the save promise reaches the form. The form then keeps "Save and close" disabled until the request settles, which stops a second click from submitting the same measurements. The changed line is line 225 of `exported-vitals-biometrics-form.workspace.tsx`, as it stands after the fix. The same commit adds two tests to `vitals-biometrics-form.test.tsx`: one checks that a double-click during a pending request saves once, and one checks that a failed save can be retried without losing the entered values.

The commit message and the ticket key are unverified links from the commit text; the diff itself confirms the change.
